A separate portion of the footage—provided to CNN by the publisher of a newly released unofficial Cruise biography—captures the actor receiving Scientology's Freedom Medal of Valor and trading military-style salutes with church leader David Miscavige as the crowd cheers. The publisher insists it did not release any other segments of the video online.

That publisher's version also shows Cruise saluting an image of L. Ron Hubbard, described on the church's website as the creator of "the only major religion founded in the 20th century." Hubbard's official biography lists a wide range of achievements, from seaman and gardener to writer and philanthropist. The Church of Scientology's website spotlights its charitable initiatives, including anti-drug programs spanning locations from Minnesota to Taiwan, as well as teacher-training work in India. He also speaks of the tranquility the faith provides, remarking, "The more you know as a Scientologist, you don't become overwhelmed by it."

The unsanctioned biography was written by Andrew Morton. Both a representative for Cruise and the Church of Scientology have challenged the book, claiming Morton never reached out to them for their input. A church statement asserted that "Accuracy and truth were not on Morton's agenda."
